outputs.explanation: Panel A shows super-resolution micrograph images (2D projection, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B shows super-resolution micrograph images (2D projection, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation), not a plot of averaged data.
Number of clusters/cell is shown as a scatter plot with individual gray dots per cell overlaid on the mean ± SEM, as stated in the caption.
Cluster sizes are shown as a scatter plot with individual gray dots per cluster overlaid on the mean ± SEM, as stated in the caption.
Proportion of clustered molecules per cell is shown as a scatter plot with individual gray dots per cell overlaid on the mean ± SEM, as stated in the caption.
Panel F shows super-resolution micrograph/trajectory images, not a plot of averaged data.
Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients and bottom is a line plot of mean square displacement per trajectory; both plot types are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel H shows trajectory and kymograph micrograph-style images, not a plot of averaged data.
